reader_summary.headline: Hello, and welcome to The Synopsis, a Speedwell Research podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hello, and welcome to The Synopsis, a Speedwell Research podcast. On this week's podcast, we are going to be reading out loud a memo we just released. If you prefer to read it, though, instead of listen to it, just go to Speedwell memos.com, the memo is free there.
